measurementScript:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$HOME/.local/opt/node-v26.9.0-linux-x64/bin:$PATH"
export GOMAXPROCS=2 GOFLAGS='-p=2 -buildvcs=false'
RUN=/tmp/harness-async-v2
UPSTREAM=/tmp/harness-async/upstream
REPO=$PWD
go test -p 2 ./tsfront -run 'TestAbaplint|TestChaiAndInitializationGo' -count=1 > "$RUN/harness-all.log" 2>&1
printf 'harness tests passed\n'
go vet ./hir/... ./tsfront/... ./internal/... ./cmd/... > "$RUN/vet.log" 2>&1
printf 'vet passed\n'
go test -short -p 2 ./hir/... ./tsfront/... ./internal/... ./cmd/... > "$RUN/short.log" 2>&1
printf 'short tests passed\n'
go build -o "$RUN/branch-abapiti" ./cmd/abapiti
(cd "$RUN/base" && go build -o "$RUN/base-abapiti" ./cmd/abapiti)
for spec in rules abap/lexer abap/statements abap/structures; do
 name=${spec##*/}
 mapfile -t files < <(cd "$UPSTREAM/packages/core" && rg --files "test/$spec" -g '*.ts' | sort)
 node tools/abaplint-tests-oracle.mjs "$RUN/node-$name.json" "$UPSTREAM" "${files[@]}" > "$RUN/node-$name.log" 2>&1
 for stage in before after; do
  if [[ $stage == before ]]; then compiler="$RUN/base-abapiti"; materializer="$RUN/base/tools/abaplint-tests-closure.mjs"; else compiler="$RUN/branch-abapiti"; materializer="$REPO/tools/abaplint-tests-closure.mjs"; fi
  node "$materializer" "$RUN/$stage-$name" "$UPSTREAM" "${files[@]}" > "$RUN/$stage-closure-$name.log" 2>&1
  "$compiler" abaplint-tests "$RUN/$stage-$name" -o "$RUN/$stage-$name-out" > "$RUN/$stage-go-$name.json" 2> "$RUN/$stage-go-$name.log" || test "$?" = 1
  node tools/abaplint-tests-report.mjs "$RUN/node-$name.json" "$RUN/$stage-go-$name.json" "$RUN/$stage-report-$name.json" > "$RUN/$stage-report-$name.log"
  node -e 'const r=require(process.argv[1]);console.log(process.argv[1],JSON.stringify({passed:r.passed,failed:r.failed,trapped:r.trapped,asyncPending:r.asyncPending,notRun:r.notRun,registered:r.registered,total:r.total}))' "$RUN/$stage-report-$name.json"
 done
done
for stage in before after; do
 node tools/abaplint-tests-summary.mjs "$RUN" "$RUN/$stage-summary.json" "$stage-"
 if [[ $stage == before ]]; then compiler="$RUN/base-abapiti"; else compiler="$RUN/branch-abapiti"; fi
 "$compiler" abaplint --full -o "$RUN/full-$stage" > "$RUN/full-$stage.log" 2>&1 || test "$?" = 1
 "$compiler" abaplint -o "$RUN/default" --target all,go > "$RUN/default-$stage.log" 2>&1
 mv "$RUN/default" "$RUN/default-$stage"
done
diff -r "$RUN/default-before" "$RUN/default-after" > "$RUN/default.diff"
printf 'default diff empty\n'
fixedRoots: Settled Promise-returning parameterless callbacks drain before recording success, preserving typed rejection messages
Suite-scoped async before/beforeEach/afterEach/after hooks run in nested suite order, replay setup failure and drain teardown
Uncertified pending work is async-pending; parameterized done callbacks remain not-run
Deferred owned mocha callbacks do not poison initialization by reading class statics
Rebased initialization recovery, contextual registration layouts and inert async suites are retained
Four-shard reports reconcile all five outcomes against original mocha title multisets
